description: This file defines the Bigint class for handling 64-bit integer operations, including byte manipulation, addition, and conversion to hexadecimal, within the ZipStream namespace.

classes.name: Bigint
classes.description: A class for representing and manipulating 64-bit integers using byte arrays, supporting operations like addition, byte conversion, and boundary checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Bigint instance with an optional integer value, filling the byte array accordingly.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Static method to create a new Bigint instance with a specified value.

methods.name: fromLowHigh
methods.description: Creates a Bigint from low and high 32-bit parts.

methods.name: getHigh32
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits of the Bigint.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from the byte array, given an end position and length.

methods.name: getLowFF
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as a float, with optional forcing.

methods.name: isOver32
methods.description: Checks if the Bigint exceeds 32 bits, considering force parameter.

methods.name: getLow32
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits as an integer.

methods.name: getHex64
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string representation of the 64-bit value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds another Bigint to this one, returning a new Bigint, and throws OverflowException on overflow.

methods.name: fillBytes
methods.description: Fills the byte array with the given integer value starting at a specified index for a specified count.
